STATE_YEAR.explain: Year from which the company says every customs file has been held in our central digital archive. Same or later than DECISION_YEAR = compatible events; earlier = a genuine contradiction.

QUOTE_DUE.explain: Date by which Nivarque promised to send the revised quote (also the due date of task A).
